name: Buckshot Dwarf
flavour: Short fuse. Shorter legs. Very long gun.
art_prompt: a squat grotesquely obese dwarf, twice as wide as he is tall, with a huge bushy black beard, a bulbous purple-red nose, tiny mean glowing red eyes under a dented black iron helmet with a spike, a dark crimson tunic under a black studded leather apron stretched over an enormous belly, a bandolier of brass shells, holding at his hip an absurdly huge black double-barrelled blunderbuss shotgun longer than he is tall with flared barrels as wide as his arms, stubby legs, huge black boots, an evil grin with a gold tooth, standing on the ground
motion: stomping in place with heavy short steps, the giant shotgun bouncing at the hip, belly and beard wobbling, glaring
doc: Stage 1's other gun: a fat, evil dwarf with a blunderbuss longer than he is tall who waddles in to five metres, well inside the cactus's reach, and fires five pellets in a cone (a red wedge on the ground for most of a second). Twice the cactus's health; the answer is to step out of the wedge, not away.
